==Standard dialogue after Priest in Peril==
* {{tcond|If the player has lost their wolfbane dagger:}}
** '''Player:''' I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
** {{Tcond|If the player's inventory is full:}}
*** '''Drezel:''' Yes I know, but you have no space for a it at the moment so I can't return it to you.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{Tcond|If the player's inventory isn't full:}}
*** {{tact|receives=wolfbane dagger}}
*** '''Player:''' I've lost my wolfbane dagger.
*** '''Drezel:''' Yes I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time. It's a family heirloom after all!
*** '''Player:''' Thanks for that!
*** {{tact|end}}
* {{tcond|If the player has lost their temple library key:}}
** '''Player:''' I've lost my library key.
** {{tact|receives=temple library key}}
** '''Drezel:''' Ok, here's another one for you.
** '''Player:''' Thanks for that!
** {{tact|end}}
* {{Tcond|Before Nature Spirit:}}
** '''Player:''' Hello again, Drezel. Is there anything that I can help you out with around here?
** {{tcond|If the player does not meet the requirements for Nature Spirit:}}

*** {{tbox|You do not meet all of the requirements to start the Nature Spirit quest.}}
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{tcond|If the player meets the requirements for Nature Spirit:}}

*** '''Drezel:''' I must warn you, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!

**** {{Topt|Yes.}}

**** '''Player:''' Sorry, not interested.
**** '''Drezel:''' Of course. I understand.

===After Nature Spirit===
* '''Player:''' Hi there! Filliman says I've completed the quest!
* '''Drezel:''' That's fantastic, well done!
* {{tact|end}}

===After Darkness of Hallowvale===
* '''Drezel:''' Hello, [player name]. How are things in Morytania?
* '''Player:''' Not as well as I'd hope, Drezel. I'm still working with the Myreque. I just hope that we can find a way to defeat those Drakans.
* '''Drezel:''' You can be sure that a great many people hope for exactly the same thing, [player name]. Good luck to you, and Myreque prevail!
* '''Player:''' Myreque prevail, Drezel.
* {{tact|end}}

===After A Taste of Hope===
* '''Drezel:''' How's everything going, [player name]?
* '''Player:''' We've managed to create a new weapon to fight the vampyres with. I used it to kill Ranis Drakan!
* '''Drezel:''' This is amazing news, [player name]. Myreque prevail!
* '''Player:''' Myreque prevail, Drezel.
* {{tact|end}}

===After Sins of the Father===
* '''Drezel:''' [player name]. How are things?
* '''Player:''' As well as they could be, everything considered. We lost everything, Drezel.
* '''Drezel:''' Not everything. There's still you, me and Ivan. Veliaf is out there somewhere as well. It's not much, but it's something to be thankful for.
* '''Player:''' I suppose.
* '''Drezel:''' Morytania has never been darker. Trust in Saradomin, friend. There is still a chance we will live through this darkness.
* {{tact|end}}

===After The Blood Moon Rises===
* '''Drezel:''' [player name]. How are things?
* '''Player:''' Not too bad, Drezel. How about here?
* '''Drezel:''' Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.
* '''Player:''' It was that or we try to kill them all, and I'm not totally sure wiping out a whole race would have been the best of ideas either... not that we'd have ever likely been able to.
* '''Drezel:''' You make a good point. And I suppose the King is behind it, even if that advisor of his isn't... Even still, I'm glad we have the Salve to stop them if they do try anything.
* '''Drezel:''' In happier news, Ivan is now able to properly focus on his studying... though he does still sneak off for the odd adventure from time to time.
* '''Player:''' Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.
* '''Drezel:''' Indeed. The important part is that he will be a worthy successor. Of that, I can be confident.
* '''Player:''' I couldn't agree more. Until next time, Drezel.
* {{tact|end}}
